# @ctd/sdk (vendored)

Built output of `packages/sdk` from
https://github.com/brozorec/stellar-confidential-token-demo, copied here because
the package is not published to npm.

Do not edit. Refresh with:

    cd <demo-repo> && pnpm install && pnpm build:sdk
    cp -R packages/sdk/dist/* <this-dir>/
